purpose: Correct ECU/source attribution and record superseding Ford bulletin without duplicating original code records

entries.translation_ar: عطل داخلي في وحدة التحكم بناقل الحركة
entries.scope: Ford Fiesta 2011-2015 / Focus 2012-2016 North America DPS6, VIN OASIS check
entries.diagnostics: Ford IDS; fault must be shown with qualifying symptoms; replace TCM only if Ford WSM/PCED diagnosis confirms

entries.ecu: TCM as communications target; reporting module not identified by bulletin
entries.translation_ar: فقد الاتصال بوحدة التحكم بناقل الحركة
entries.scope: Ford Fiesta 2011-2015 / Focus 2012-2016 North America DPS6, VIN OASIS check
entries.diagnostics: Check network power/grounds/connectivity and Ford WSM/PCED before interpreting as failed TCM

entries.ecu: TCM as data source; reporting module not identified by bulletin
entries.definition_en: Invalid Internal Control Module Monitoring Data Received From TCM
entries.translation_ar: استقبال بيانات مراقبة داخلية غير صالحة من وحدة التحكم بناقل الحركة
entries.scope: Ford Fiesta 2011-2015 / Focus 2012-2016 North America DPS6, VIN OASIS check
entries.diagnostics: Review TCM communication and module calibration; WSM/PCED test required

entries.translation_ar: توقيت كامة العادم متأخر أكثر من المسموح للبنك 1
entries.scope: Ford 2013 gasoline VCT monitor; NOT listed in DPS6 14M02 DTC table
entries.diagnostics: Check VCT commanded vs actual position, oil/solenoid control and cam timing by Ford VIN-specific PCED

entries.translation_ar: عدم تطابق توقيت عمود المرفق وعمود الكامات للبنك 1
entries.scope: Ford 2013 gasoline VCT monitor; NOT listed in DPS6 14M02 DTC table
entries.diagnostics: Check crank/cam correlation per engine calibration; Ford 2013 overview says one tooth/16 crank degrees typical misalignment monitor threshold; not universal

entries.scope: Ford 2013 monitor preconditions list code P0017 but no inspected table establishes specific definition; NOT listed in DPS6 14M02
entries.diagnostics: Obtain VIN-specific PCM WSM/PCED; do not label as DPS6 TCM failure

entries.scope: 2021–2024 Ford F-150 3.5L PowerBoost, North America; TSB 25-2142 supersedes 24-2442
entries.diagnostics: Battery condition test, then update BCM/ACCM/TCCM per superseding TSB; battery replacement only if condition test fails
